action_template.title: CW Inlet Temperature Exceedance
checklist: Check cooling tower fan operation and adjust speed
Verify CW pump discharge pressure and flow rate
Inspect CW basin level and makeup water supply
Review ambient conditions and adjust setpoints if needed
Coordinate with utilities for additional cooling capacity
action_template.expected_effect: Restore CW inlet to <{max}°C within 4-6 hours

action_template.title: Inhibitor Dosing Interruption
checklist: Verify inhibitor tank level and refill if below 20%
Check dosing pump operation and calibration
Inspect injection point for blockages or leaks
Confirm flow meter readings match expected rates
Review alarm logs for root cause identification
action_template.expected_effect: Restore continuous dosing to ≥99.5% within 2 hours

action_template.title: Column ΔP Index Elevated
checklist: Review column internals inspection schedule
Check feed quality and contaminant levels
Verify reflux ratio and column loading
Assess tray/packing condition from recent data
Plan cleaning or maintenance window if trend continues
action_template.expected_effect: Stabilize ΔP Index below {max} within 12-24 hours

action_template.title: Reactor Temperature Oscillation High
checklist: Check reactor cooling system operation
Verify temperature controller tuning parameters
Inspect feed temperature and flow stability
Review catalyst bed condition indicators
Adjust control loop settings if needed
action_template.expected_effect: Reduce oscillation to <{max}°C p-p within 6-8 hours

action_template.title: AA Dimer Level Elevated
checklist: Review column bottom temperature setpoint
Check reboiler duty and heat transfer
Verify residence time in bottom section
Assess product draw-off rate adjustments
Schedule additional lab sampling for trend confirmation
action_template.expected_effect: Reduce dimer level to <{max} wt% within 24-48 hours

action_template.title: MeHQ Level Low
checklist: Verify MeHQ dosing pump operation
Check MeHQ tank inventory level
Confirm injection point flow and pressure
Review recent lab results for trend
Increase dosing rate if below threshold
action_template.expected_effect: Restore MeHQ to ≥180 ppm within 4-6 hours

action_template.title: Multiple Process Excursions Detected
checklist: Review alarm summary for common patterns
Identify root cause of threshold violations
Check control system setpoints and limits
Verify instrument calibration accuracy
Implement corrective actions for top offenders
action_template.expected_effect: Reduce excursion rate to ≤3/24h within 12 hours
